$comment: A portable, secret-free fragment of ~/.claude/settings.json. provision-toolset.sh deep-merges it into your personal settings without overwriting existing keys. There are NO secrets and no mcpServers here — MCP servers are installed separately from config/mcp-manifest.json.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\b(pip|pip3)\s+install\b'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Use uv instead of pip' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+/[^a-zA-Z]'; then echo 'BLOCKED: rm -rf / is forbidden' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE 'taskkill.*/+IM.*(claude|node)\.exe'; then echo 'BLOCKED: global taskkill /IM claude.exe|node.exe kills EVERY Claude Code session machine-wide. Target a specific PID instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE '\b(pkill|killall)\b.*(claude|node)([^a-zA-Z]|$)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: pkill/killall claude|node kills all sessions. Target a specific PID instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi
